description:
Wrapper-level differential test for pkix_chain::verify_tls_server against 'openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname X'.

Mirrors the structure of pkix-difftest/tests/verify_wrapper_pyca.rs (PKIX-fmtv.19): drive the curated RFC 6125 corpus from pkix-chain/tests/fixtures/ through both verifiers, classify per-case agreement, emit a matrix.

Acceptance:
- pkix-difftest/tests/verify_wrapper_openssl_server.rs runs the corpus and asserts zero Rust-looser cases.
- pkix-difftest/baseline-verify-openssl.md gets a TLS-server section with per-case agreement table.

Blocks on PKIX-fmtv.18.1.
title: OpenSSL diff: verify_tls_server vs -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname
